$comment: FORM P5-T9e admission, written 2026-11-18: the top-level aggregates[] became concepts[].composition on the ROOT concept (an aggregate has no identity apart from its root; every corpus aggregate was named == root or <Root>Aggregate and no root had two). Same members minus name/root, so the net budget change is -2 slots (aggregate.name, aggregate.root and pack:aggregates out; concept.composition in; the six member slots are renamed aggregate.* -> composition.*).

declarative.why: names the owned child collections of a root concept and the cross-collection invariants and balances over the whole draft tree; onValidate/onCommit only NAME a procedure run in the commit transaction; no ordering of steps

notLower.why: reading and saving a root with its owned children WHOLE in one transaction, with the draft-tree invariants checked before commit, is a runtime capability (/api/v1/runtime/aggregate/<Concept>) that no expression, function or flow step provides

twice.note: collections: all three plus AppGen WmsOffice; invariants/balances/onValidate/onCommit: dsl-conformance-max and WmsOffice (the same coverage the old aggregates[] had, tracked by check-dsl-coverage)

enforced.note: booted probes 30, 85, 88 and 89 drive the aggregate endpoint (invariants, lifecycle, allowed actions, onValidate veto); unit tests AggregateWorkbenchExpansionTest, AggregateBalanceValidationTest and BackOfficeConfigThreadingTest-style threading tests fail if a member stops reaching the compiled model

taught.bundleLine: `composition` on the ROOT concept: `{"collections":[{"name":"lines","concept":"OrderLine","childField":"orderId"}],"invariants":[],"balances":[],"onValidate":"<procedure>","onCommit":"<procedure>"}` -- the root and its collections are read and saved whole in one transaction; refer to it as `"aggregate":"<Concept>"`
